summary: Strawberry Fields REIT filed an 8-K announcing a Q2 2026 cash dividend of $0.17 per common share declared by its Board on May 7, 2026. The dividend is payable in cash on June 30, 2026 to holders of record as of June 16, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation event. The filing includes a press release and cover page XBRL. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action warranting special-situations classification occurs; it is an ordinary capital return to shareholders.
